releases.name: Roguewake
releases.summary:
Embark on an epic Roguelike Deckbuilder Pirate Adventure in this thrilling turn-based strategy game! Navigate treacherous seas and face formidable foes as you strategically choose items for a dynamic slot machine-like grid. Watch as items randomly appear, interact with each other, and provide valuable resources for your daring adventure and combat encounters.

Conquer enemies, survive perilous encounters, and progress through a procedurally generated map, revealing new challenges and opportunities at every turn.

Will you navigate the unpredictable seas, defeat formidable enemies, and uncover the mysteries of the procedurally generated world? Test your wits and luck in this captivating Roguelike Deckbuilder Pirate Adventure!

releases.name: 100 Cats Lost in Norway Find & Color
CloserLook VR: Oldways
releases.summary:
CloserLook VR: Oldways invites you into a painstakingly crafted modern West African world, where you awaken as Tessy, a final-year student trapped in a university building steeped in secrets. 

As you search for an escape, each puzzle becomes a thread in a larger conspiracy, guiding you from quiet libraries to hidden temples while the shadow of a mysterious organization grows closer.

releases.name: Seafarer: The Ship Sim
releases.summary: For anybody from age 6 to99.Just position and rotate the pieces so that all animals have the proper front and back.it seems easy at first to position the 9 pieces correctly, but it is actually really tricky and the end the darn last piece doesn't match.If you like, or if after hours and days you still haven't solved it yet, you can switch to level 1.  This is much simpler because the pieces are already rotated correctly and you "only" have to find their right spot.Aaron's darn puzzle game is a learning game that trains and encourages focus and spatial intellect.++++ Features:Two levels of difficulty- Level 1 = easy- Level 2 = difficult, the pieces have to also be rotated correctlyYou can set the level of the backgroundmusik and sounds or turn them of separatly.If you have suggestions or ideas we are more than happy to learn about them.  Just use the build in message-feature from the Infoscreen.

releases.name: 3-Bit Explorer
releases.summary:
The ringing of the bell seems to have taken you even further from your own reality. You hoped to find a great adventure, but you couldn't imagine that this would left you stranded between realities. The bell also seems to be changing with every leap you take, gaining power and... features? Last time it gained eyes that watched over your, but now it seems to gain teeth that move slowly in your backpack.

3-Bit Explorer follows its predecessors, being a game focused on world exploration. This time you find yourself lost in a forest that seems to have EVEN MORE bits than you, making this world even stranger to our hero. Once more, the world does not need saving, but you need to find your way home (and also a good adventure).

releases.name: Mars Attracts
releases.summary: Mars Attracts is a park management sim set in the iconic universe of Mars Attacks™. Play as the devious Martians as you construct detailed enclosures, manage staff, and most importantly - abduct and experiment on humans for the entertainment of your Martian guests!

releases.name: CoLane
releases.summary: CoLane is a rhythm game where the lanes switch according to the color of the background spotlight. It features a variety of fingerings, making it a game where you improve through trial and error.
